title: OTWD data repository configuration
description: The format of otwd.json, at the root of a data repository (ADR 0046): the country the repository holds data for, and the schema tag its records conform to. CI validates every pull request against that tag.

country.description: The country this data repository holds data for, such as AU for opentouring/otwd-au.

schema.description: The tag on opentouring/opentouring that this repository's records conform to, such as v1.0.0-draft.1. A schema change that needs data changed lands as its own migration pull request that updates this tag.
